verdict.score_rationale: The board lands between the composition-fails and flat anchors because its orderly panel grid remains readable, but extensive dead space, yellow-note monotony, and widespread substitution of prose boxes for operational-map objects leave it visibly unfinished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Fail: the eight panels occupy the frame, but most contain large empty interiors, with especially broad unused bands around sections 3–6 and beneath the content.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Fail: nearly every process is rendered as the same yellow note regardless of semantics, overwhelming the few registry-true yellow, red, and blue icons.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Pass: no crosshair junctions, waypoint terminations, floating badges, or ambiguous wire merges are visible.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Fail: panel headers and outer registers are orderly, but inconsistent note sizes, sparse icon use, and uneven internal placement create accidental rather than deliberate density variation.
